title: Parts Charged on a Job in a Circle Credit Measurement
content:
Parts charged on a job under Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair are brought into the part of a
charge a Northbeam Circle Membership's benefit credit is measured against, on the reading the job's own
figures give.

## The readings

| Parts charged on the job in the 12 months ending on the handling day | Standing of the job | The parts taken |
|---|---|---|
| At or above the least labour billed on that service at its labour rate | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | The parts charged as they stand |
| Above nothing but below that least labour figure | Scheduled, dispatched or held for parts | The parts charged net of the parts markup that service applies |
| Any | Any other standing | No parts are taken |
| Nothing | Any | No parts are taken |

Where the parts charged on the job in the twelve months ending on the handling day stand at or above the
least labour billed on that service at its labour rate and the job stands scheduled, dispatched or held for
parts, the parts taken are the parts charged as they stand. Where the parts charged on the job in that window
stand above nothing but below the least labour billed on that service at its labour rate and the job stands
scheduled, dispatched or held for parts, the parts taken are the parts charged net of the parts markup that
service applies. Where neither of those holds, no parts are taken.

## Reading the second tier

Taking the parts charged net of the markup that service applies means undoing the markup that was added: on
a hypothetical parts charge of 264.00 on a service applying a markup of 10 percent, the parts taken are
240.00, the figure that markup was applied to. The first tier takes the parts charged with the markup left
on.

## Boundary between the two tiers

On a job standing scheduled, dispatched or held for parts whose service bills a least labour of 168.00 at its
labour rate, parts charged of 168.00 fall in the first tier and are taken as they stand; parts charged of
167.99 fall in the second and are taken net of the markup; parts charged of nothing fall to the third tier
and nothing is taken. A job standing in any other way takes no parts however much stands charged on it.
